privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires enabling 'Full Multiple Companies Support' in Settings. Three companies must be created: 'Meridian Technologies', 'Meridian Media', and 'Meridian Healthcare'. Asset tags ASSET-MT001/002/003 map to Technologies; ASSET-MM001/002/003 map to Media; ASSET-MH001/002/003 map to Healthcare. No other assets should have their company field changed.
